english.title: Fly non-UK aircraft in Required Navigation Performance airspace in UK w/o required area navigation equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of an aircraft **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) registered in **(..SPECIFY COUNTRY..) which flew, without

(C)_[authorisation from the appropriate]_
(D)_[complying with instructions given by the]_

United Kingdom air traffic control unit, in Required Navigation Performance airspace in the United Kingdom when

(E)_[it was not equipped with area navigation equipment so as to comply with the law of the country of registration in so far as that law required it to be so equipped when flying within designated required navigation performance airspace]_
(F)_[the navigation equipment with which the aircraft was equipped was not capable of being operated so as to enable the aircraft to maintain the navigation performance capability notified for the airspace in which the aircraft was flying]_
(G)_[the navigation equipment with which the aircraft was equipped was not operated so as to enable the aircraft to maintain the navigation performance capability notified for the airspace in which the aircraft was flying]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 85 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
were the operator/pilot in command of an aircraft registered in a country outside the United Kingdom which flew, without
authorisation from or complying with instructions given by the appropriate United Kingdom air traffic control unit,
in Required Navigation Performance airspace in the United Kingdom when
it was not equipped with area navigation equipment so as to comply with the law of the country of registration in so far as that law required it to be so equipped when flying within designated required navigation performance airspace OR
the navigation equipment with which the aircraft was equipped was not capable of being operated so as to enable the aircraft to maintain the navigation performance capability notified for the airspace in which the aircraft was flying OR
the navigation equipment with which the aircraft was equipped was not operated so as to enable the aircraft to maintain the navigation performance capability notified for the airspace in which the aircraft was flying
